subject.title: feat(channels): core-owned durable ingress drain — one turn-adoption lifecycle for Telegram and WhatsApp

question: Should createChannelIngressDrain/openChannelIngressDrain and turnAdoptionLifecycle become a permanent public plugin SDK/runtime contract in this PR?
rationale: Repository policy sets a high bar for new public plugin APIs, and the contributor's proposed boundary has no visible human maintainer confirmation despite the protected product-decision signals on the canonical issue and this PR.

options.title: Confirm the narrow public seam
options.body: Approve the drain factory, lifecycle binding, limited tuning constants, process identity helper, and associated types as the permanent supported contract.

options.title: Keep the drain core-internal
options.body: Land the shared implementation for bundled channels without publishing a general external plugin contract until a concrete external consumer proves the API shape.

options.title: Defer the architecture change
options.body: Keep the current channel-specific implementations until another channel adoption and live proof can validate the common abstraction.

recommendation.title: Confirm the narrow public seam
recommendation.body: Approve the drain factory, lifecycle binding, limited tuning constants, process identity helper, and associated types as the permanent supported contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged ownership of plugin SDK narrowing and shared channel primitives makes this the strongest available routing signal for the API-boundary choice.
